desc: Ideation: identify autocorrelation convolution and candidate methods (NTT, numpy FFT, complement, direct, bitset).

Implement a complete runnable Python program with the numpy FFT main path, fast input, early exits, correct transform length, vectorized answer extraction, and a direct fallback; ensure it prints output for all samples.
Add/verify fallbacks for no-numpy or small inputs and edge cases (N<3, full interval, max(S) power-of-two boundary).
Verify public samples (all 3 passed) and review large-path correctness/performance for N=1e6, max(S)=1e6.
